description: Agent Waste and Recycling Records: submit facility and scale records with the permit, manifest and disposition records they answer to: each facility record with its id, reference, name and the waste types it covers; each hauler the permit record lists with its id, permit reference and name; each waste manifest with its id, manifest number and quantity; each inbound load on a scale ticket with its id, ticket number, facility, hauler, the manifest it carries, waste type, gross, tare and net weights and the moment weighed in; each disposal or processing record with its id, reference, the scale ticket it disposes of or processes, its kind (disposal or processing) and the moment recorded. The signed report gives the scale tickets and the records behind them, each load’s hauler against the permit record, each ticket’s net weight against the manifest it names, each load’s waste type against its facility’s own record, and each load against the disposal or processing record behind it, and counts them, and names divergent facility records: an inbound load recorded from a hauler the permit record does not list, a scale weight the manifest quantity contradicts, a facility receiving a waste type its own record does not cover, and a facility entry with no corresponding disposal or processing record; then a scale ticket whose net weight is not its gross less its tare and a disposal or processing record naming a load the facility record does not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No inbound loads, no permit record beside loads that name a hauler, or no disposal or processing records beside loads leaves those points unverified. Tickets, manifests and facilities match by letters and digits, haulers by permit reference or name, waste types by their words, a load’s net weight is its stated net or its gross less its tare, read to the hundredth, and a facility record listing no types covers any. This reads the tipping and scale record at the gate: whether every load came from a permitted hauler, weighed what its manifest says and went to disposal or processing. Verdict waste_facility_record_divergent, waste_facility_record_partial, waste_facility_record_unverified or waste_facility_record_consistent. POST /api/waste-facility-record-check. Reads the waste and recycling records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it hauls no waste, operates no facility, contacts no regulator, hauler or disposal site and issues no permit or certification, which stay with the waste operation, its haulers, its facilities and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Waste and Recycling Records reads a waste operation’s own records: waste manifest records, hauler permit records, disposal and landfill records, recycling processing records, diversion and recovery records, pickup and collection log records, facility and scale records and contamination report records, each against the hauler permit, facility, receiving and disposal records, the waste types, areas and dates in the pickup log, the manifests and the dates the record states, the inbound, outbound and residue records, the processing, reuse, disposal and pickup totals, the service record, the scale tickets and dispositions, or the follow-up entries and the inspected load counts on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the waste stream: what the manifest shows, what the disposal record supports, what the permits cover, and whether the diversion claims and pickup logs hold up; it reads records about waste streams and the people who move them, not live environmental monitoring and not cleanup services: the Agent Energy family reads utility and generation records, the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production records, the Agent Food Safety Records family reads a food business’s safety file and the Agent Aviation Records family reads an air operator’s flight and maintenance paper trail, while this family reads a waste operation’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-waste-recycling-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-waste-recycling-records/.
